breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d^4 / 32 for both the shear stress formula (τ_max = T c / J) and the angle of twist formula (φ = T L / (J G)). There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 anywhere in the specification, which matches the ground truth prompt that omits that erroneous instruction entirely.
